abilities.name: Boomerangs!!!!
abilities.description: Throws three boomerangs that returns after hitting an enemy or wall. If caught the player will gain increased attack and movement speed for a short time. Boomerangs have a chance to stun. This ability has a stock of 4.

abilities.name: Boomerang of the Wind
abilities.description: Throws a large boomerang that deals damage to enemies it passes through. If caught the player will gain increased attack and movement speed for a short time. Additionally, catching the Boomerang will reduce cooldowns. The Boomerang has a chance to stun.

abilities.name: Big Bomb
abilities.description: Throws a timed bomb for big damage and causes knockback to enemies damaged by it.

abilities.name: Tiny Bombs
abilities.description: Throws out small, timed bombs that explodes dealing damage to targets. This ability has a stock of 5.

abilities.name: Mysterious Urn
abilities.description: Throws a mysterious urn for area damage and a random bonus.

abilities.name: Big Bawk Bomb
abilities.description: Throws a timed bomb for big damage and causes knockback to enemies damaged by it. These spawn chickens that attack enemies for a brief duration.

stages.name: Bawk Bomb Effect Minion Attack Bow

abilities.name: Tiny Bawk Bombs
abilities.description: Throws out small, timed bombs that explodes dealing damage to targets. These spawn chickens that attack enemies for a brief duration. This ability has a stock of 5.

abilities.name: Nimble Dance
abilities.description: A parry attack dealing damage in a cone and grants the user an invulnerability bubble for a short time. Nimble Dance removes one Melody. If used correctly during Bardsong buff it will add one Melody.

abilities.name: Melody
abilities.description: Melody is used for bards abilities and is generated from the Bardsong buff. Gaining melody rotates through the bardsongs abilities. Having high melody will also increase the bards basic attack.

abilities.name: Singing Crystal
abilities.description: Throw out a singing crystal onto the ground. Whenever a song is used to buff nearby players, the area of effect is around both the bard and crystal. After using the ability Singing Crystal swaps into Crystal Pop.

abilities.name: Epic Riff
abilities.description: Starts the Bardsong buff and adds one to Melody. Bardsong periodically spawns icons above the bards head. If the player uses the ability that matches the icon while it is active, they will gain Melody. All Melody is lost when Bardsong buff ends.

abilities.name: Jubilant Song
abilities.description: Causes nearby allies to dance and gain increased movement speed and max energy. Buffs allies with a chance to restore energy when dealing damage. Removes three Melody when used.

abilities.name: Peaceful Song
abilities.description: Heals nearby allies and buffs them with life gain when dealing damage for a short time. Additionally applies stun to nearby enemies. Removes three Melody when used.

abilities.name: Bardsong
abilities.description: Maintains Melody as long as the correct Abilities are used.

abilities.name: Vanilla Swirlwind
abilities.description: The Candy Barbarian spins around, attacking all nearby foes and creating Healing Candy for himself.

abilities.name: Gum Drop
abilities.description: When attacked, the Candy Barbarian will sometimes drop rage-inducing Gum Drops, increasing attack speed, movement speed and physical damage.

abilities.name: Sugar Crash
abilities.description: The Candy Barbarian leaps at enemies, dealing damage over an area and creating Gum Drops.

abilities.name: Eis-Crom Cone
abilities.description: The Candy Barbarian drops a large ice cream cone, dealing damage over an area, creating Gum Drops, and dropping Healing Candy for allies.

abilities.name: Sweet Candy
abilities.description: It's good for you!

abilities.name: Sour Candy
abilities.description: Makes you run and attack more quickly.

abilities.name: Green Gatling
abilities.description: Throw a seed that grows into a plant. It will fire at a nearby target dealing damage. Healing your plants will make them grow faster.

stages.name: Seedling Lasher Effect Bulb Fullhealth Aoe Effect Damage

abilities.name: Leafy Lasher
abilities.description: Lob a seed that grows into a plant that will damage and snare nearby enemies when fully grown. Healing your plants will make them grow faster.

stages.name: Big Seedling Lasher Effect Bulb Fullhealth Aoe Effect Damage

abilities.name: Empowered Growth
abilities.description: Empowers your Leafy Lasher and Green Gatling, allowing them to grow larger, faster! Green Gatling deals increased Damage. Leafy Lasher snare gains additional effectiveness.

abilities.name: Touchdown
abilities.description: Become supercharged while gliding. When you land create a shockwave in front of your landing destination.

abilities.name: Force Flash
abilities.description: Pulse kinetic energy that damages nearby enemies while increasing movement speed and damage resistance.

abilities.name: Fired Up
abilities.description: Infuse yourself with energy, increasing Jump, Damage and Attack Speed.

abilities.name: Laser Leap
abilities.description: Swap into ranged mode and leap backwards, gaining energy.

abilities.name: Plasma Blast
abilities.description: Detonate pure energy, dealing damage directly around you.

abilities.name: Eyebeam
abilities.description: Deal damage to enemies in front of you, increasing their damage taken from all sources.

abilities.name: Hero's Charge
abilities.description: Swap into melee mode and dash forward, healing yourself. Nearby enemies are pulled towards you.

abilities.name: Dino Buddy Food
abilities.description: Killing an enemy caught in your Clever Snare will create meat that resets the cooldown on your Dino Buddy ability. Primary attack fires darts.

abilities.name: Clever Snare
abilities.description: Throws a sticky net which roots, energy drains, and damages enemies within its area over time. Hold button for larger nets that last longer and can be thrown farther. Dart attacks refresh the net.

abilities.name: Dino Buddy
abilities.description: Throws a piece of meat on the ground which summons a random dinosaur to fight nearby enemies. Dino Buddies last 22 seconds.

abilities.name: Dino Mount
abilities.description: Summons a special mount that increases Magic Damage and Movement Speed, adds splash damage to your dart attacks, stuns nearby foes when you call a Dino Buddy, and makes all Clever Snare nets max size!

abilities.name: Spit Fire
abilities.description: If charged, your Familiar releases a fireball that deals damage over a small area. Damaging enemies with your basic attack will charge up your Familiar.

abilities.name: Fireborn
abilities.description: The Dracolyte's attacks cause enemies to Burn, increasing their damage taken from all sources. The Dracolyte also moves much faster through lava, and takes less damage from it than other Trovians.

abilities.name: Lil' Dragon
abilities.description: A little dragon

abilities.name: Burnt Offering
abilities.description: Throws a Dragon Idol on the ground that explodes after 3 seconds. The Dracolyte's attacks can detonate the Idol early, dealing damage over an area.

abilities.name: Avatar of Flame
abilities.description: Transforms the Dracolyte into a dragon for 15 seconds, increasing movement speed, health regeneration, stability, and the damage done by the basic attack, while reducing damage taken to 50%.

abilities.name: Ego Blast
abilities.description: If the Trickster has taken no damage for four seconds, their basic attack deals bonus damage.

abilities.name: Blink
abilities.description: Teleports the Trickster, leaving a decoy behind that enemies will attack.

abilities.name: Glitterbomb
abilities.description: Throws a shiny bomb which deals damage in an area and stuns enemies.

abilities.name: Faerie Dance
abilities.description: Summon 3 enchanted staves to attack the Trickster's enemies.

abilities.name: Lucky Shot
abilities.description: While in the air, damage dealt to enemies decreases the speed of the Gunslinger's descent. Dealing damage can cause the next Charged Sniper Shot to be full power without any charging time.

abilities.name: Charged Sniper Shot
abilities.description: Hold Charged Shot for up to 0.85 seconds to increase its damage and radius. Applies a debuff that increases damage done to the target for 5 seconds. At max Charge when targets are below 35% health they take additional damage.

abilities.name: Charged Shot
abilities.description: Good things come to those who wait.

abilities.name: Blast Jump
abilities.description: Launches the Gunslinger up into the air, damaging any nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Run and Gun
abilities.description: Increases the Gunslinger's Movement Speed and Attack Speed, and allows the Gunslinger to run full speed while attacking.

abilities.name: Ice Crash
abilities.description: Drops an icicle from the heavens, dealing damage over an area that chills enemies, slowing their movement speed. Also turns lava blocks into water blocks for a short time.

abilities.name: Coldhearted
abilities.description: The Ice Sage's basic attack chills enemies, slowing their movement speed. Additionally, Ice Sages can walk across ice without slipping.

abilities.name: The Big Chill
abilities.description: Freezes and damages all enemies around the Ice Sage for 3.5 seconds doing frostbite damage while frozen.

abilities.name: Frozen Ward
abilities.description: Increases the movement speed, damage, and attack speed of the Ice Sage while active. Reduces all incoming damage by 50% for a short time.

abilities.name: Pain Freeze
abilities.description: The Ice Sage's empowered basic attack freezes for 1 second on the first hit. It also chills enemies, slowing their movement speed. Enemies hit three times with Basic Attack while "Pain Freeze" is equipped explode taking additional damage. Ice Sages can still walk across ice without slipping.

abilities.name: Retribution
abilities.description: Every time the Knight takes damage, they will store up Retribution that increases the damage of their next attack. This can stack up to 3 times dealing additional damage for each stack. Basic attacks reduce targets outgoing damage by up to 10%. Additional attacks refresh this debuff.

abilities.name: Smash
abilities.description: Damages and briefly taunts all enemies in a cone in front of the Knight.

abilities.name: Charge!
abilities.description: Launches the Knight forward, taunting, stunning and damaging passing enemies.

abilities.name: Iron Will
abilities.description: Fully heals the Knight and reduces incoming damage by 50%. 7 nearby Trovians take 10% less damage and redirect 10% of incoming damage to the Knight for 10 seconds.

abilities.name: Grapple
abilities.description: Pull yourself towards your target. On impact deals light damage to nearby enemies.

abilities.name: Lunacy
abilities.description: Using abilities or attacking enemies gives Moon Power. Gather enough to become infused with the power of the moon. Lunar Lancers gain Moon Power instead of energy.

abilities.name: Lunar Leap
abilities.description: Jump up into the air and gain a slow fall. For a short time your grapple becomes Lunar Infused, dealing increased damage. After damaging enemies you gain an attack buff.

abilities.name: Lunarform
abilities.description: This ability can be used at max Moon Power. When used you transform gaining increased movement speed, 50% reduced damage, and 130% increased attack damage. Moon Power drains over time and at zero you revert to your basic form.

stages.name: Two Hit Combo Transformed Effect 2Nd Hit Override

abilities.name: Lunar Infused Grapple
abilities.description: Pull yourself towards your target. On impact deals heavy damage to nearby enemies, triggering a physical damage buff.

stages.name: Spear Throw Grapple Effect Explosion Buffed
Moon Blessing Spawn Meteor Effect Trigger
Moon Blessing Spawn Meteor Effect Explosion

abilities.name: Eclipse Spear
abilities.description: Throw a spear that deals area damage. Costs Moon Power.

abilities.name: Lunar Slam
abilities.description: Jump up high into the air and slam down dealing high damage and stunning enemies. Costs Moon Power.

abilities.name: Shadow Flip
abilities.description: The Neon Ninja flips forward and enters Stealth Mode for 3 seconds, granting invisibility and a movement speed increase.

abilities.name: Shining Star
abilities.description: The Neon Ninja's attacks can generate up to three Throwing Stars, which are thrown when using the basic attack while in Stealth Mode. This attack deals double critical damage when charges are at max.

abilities.name: Stasis Blade
abilities.description: The Neon Ninja dashes forward. Enemies struck take damage and are rooted in place for 2 seconds.

abilities.name: Final Technique
abilities.description: The Neon Ninja's basic attacks hurl damaging energy swords which refresh the duration of Stasis Blade on enemies.

abilities.name: Plunderbuss
abilities.description: Attacking enemies causes them to drop Doubloons, which generate energy and increase the damage of any active First Mate turret.

abilities.name: First Mate
abilities.description: The Pirate's First Mate mans a turret that attacks enemies. Each time First Mate is used, it can be upgraded by picking up Doubloons.

abilities.name: Parrot
abilities.description: Squawk

abilities.name: Pretend Pirate
abilities.description: Throws down a booby-trapped decoy that enemies will attack.

abilities.name: Dark Whispers
abilities.description: Nearby enemies periodically receive a Shadow Mark, increasing damage done to them as well as making them visible through walls. When the Shadow Hunter uses a basic attack on Shadow Marked targets a small explosion is triggered at the target and the Shadow Hunter will gain one Seeker. Additionally, when dodging the Shadow Hunter gains a movement speed boost for a short time.

abilities.name: Sun Snare
abilities.description: Throws a blinding trap which stuns and damages all nearby enemies for 2 seconds when triggered. Enemies damaged by it will also gain Shadow Mark.

abilities.name: Arrow of the Goddess
abilities.description: Applies Shadowmark to all nearby enemies. Empowers the Shadow Hunter's next Radiant Arrow, increasing its damage, doubling critical damage, and causing it to knock enemies back.

abilities.name: Radiant Arrow
abilities.description: An attack that can pierce through enemies and walls. Hold for at least 1 second to charge, causing it to deal extra damage to Shadowmarked enemies.

abilities.name: Guiding Light
abilities.description: Summon a pillar of light at target location that expands over time and deals damage to enemies in the area. Applies a Damage over time effect that gives Divine Radiance and Energy to the Solarion. Additionally, friendly targets will be healed. If Phoenix is in egg form this will cause the egg to explode faster. This ability has a stock of 3 and can be cast in rapid succession.

abilities.name: Prismatic Blast
abilities.description: Continually creates a Blast of energy that deals damage to enemies in an area around The Solarion. Each Blast costs energy, and buffs your Damage, Damage Reduction, Stability, and Movement Speed which stacks up to 5 times lasting until Prismatic Blast ends. Toggles off at zero energy

abilities.name: Vengeful Spirits
abilities.description: Basic attacks and Bulwark Bash return 5% of damage dealt in health after the first attack. Basic attack applies a debuff to targets increasing damage from all sources by 5%. Lasts 5 seconds. A Spirit Wraith will spawn to protect you from death, empowering you until it can do so again.

abilities.name: Bulwark Bash
abilities.description: Damages and briefly taunts all enemies in a cone in front of the Revenant.

abilities.name: Spirit Spears
abilities.description: Damages enemies in a cone in front of the Revenant when held. Costs health to use. Activation drains 3% and each tick thereafter drains 5%. Press again to cancel.

abilities.name: Spirit Storm
abilities.description: A cyclone pulls foes toward the Revenant and randomly fires exploding spirit blasts, which damage enemies and heal players for 5%. Costs 20% health to use.

stages.name: Ultimate Spirit Storm Aoe Npc Damage

abilities.name: Bonetourage
abilities.description: Consume all Restless Souls to attract Skellittles to fight for you. If you already have 6 Skellittles your excess Restless Souls will instead choose a Skellittle to possess for 30 seconds, causing them to take and deal increased damage.

abilities.name: Banshee's Boon
abilities.description: Turns you into a ghost, which reduces damage taken by 90% and causes your primary attacks to affect all nearby enemies and Skellittles. Banshee's Boon rapidly depletes your energy and ends when energy reaches 0.

abilities.name: Grave Goliath
abilities.description: Gather the Restless Souls possessing your Skellittles to summon a Grave Goliath! The more Skellittles that are possessed, the stronger the Grave Goliath is.
